### 📘 Differential and Integral Calculus

::: {.home-feature .home-feature-ensaios}

## 👤 About the author {#about-the-author}

A blog by **Celso Marcellini**, sharing explanations, courses, and reflections on mathematics, statistics, physics, and programming. The aim is to make deep ideas accessible to curious learners, with conceptual clarity and thoughtful presentation.

[📘 About me and the blog](posts/personal/about-the-blog.qmd){.home-about-link}
